data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: autumn
sections.question: autumn
sections.summary: the season after summer and before winter, when leaves fall from trees

senses.definition: the season after summer and before winter, when the weather gets cooler and leaves fall from the trees
examples: The leaves turn red and orange in autumn.
She loves autumn because of the beautiful colours in the park.

answers.answer: The leaves turn red, yellow, and orange in autumn.
She wears a swimsuit every day in autumn because the weather is so hot.
He goes skiing every autumn because there is deep snow everywhere.
They spend every autumn on the beach because the days are long and warm.

sections.title: cloudy
sections.question: cloudy
sections.summary: having a lot of clouds in the sky

senses.definition: with a lot of clouds in the sky so that the sun cannot be seen clearly
examples: It was cloudy all day so they could not see the sun.
The sky is very cloudy today, so it might rain later.

answers.answer: It was cloudy all day so they stayed inside and watched a film.
She went sunbathing in the garden because it was such a lovely cloudy day.
He put on his sunglasses because it was very cloudy and bright outside.
They had a perfect day at the beach because it was cloudy and warm all day.

sections.title: cold
sections.question: cold
sections.summary: having a low temperature; not warm

senses.definition: having a low temperature; not warm
examples: It was so cold outside that she wore her winter coat.
The water in the lake was very cold, so nobody went swimming.

senses.definition: a common illness that makes you sneeze and have a sore throat
examples: She caught a cold after walking in the rain without a coat.

answers.answer: It was so cold outside that she put on her hat, scarf, and gloves.
She wore a bikini to the beach because it was cold and perfect for sunbathing.
He turned on the fan because it was too cold in the room.
They opened all the windows because the room was cold and they wanted fresh air.

sections.title: hot
sections.question: hot
sections.summary: having a high temperature; very warm

senses.definition: having a high temperature; feeling very warm
examples: It was so hot that they went to the beach to cool down.
The weather was hot and sunny all week during the summer holidays.

answers.answer: It was so hot that they went to the beach to cool down.
She put on her thickest winter coat because it was so hot outside.
He turned on the heating because the room was too hot.
She wore her scarf and gloves because it was hot and she felt cold.

examples: It was a rainy afternoon so they stayed inside and played board games.
November is usually the rainiest month of the year in England.

answers.answer: It was a rainy afternoon so they stayed inside and watched a film.
She wore her sunglasses because it was such a rainy, bright day.
They decided to have a picnic in the park because it was a rainy day.
He went sunbathing in the garden because it was a beautiful rainy day.

sections.title: snowy
sections.question: snowy
sections.summary: covered with snow; having a lot of snow

senses.definition: covered with snow or having a lot of snow falling
examples: The children were happy because it was a snowy day and they could build a snowman.
The roads were dangerous because of the snowy conditions.

answers.answer: The children played outside all day because it was snowy and they built a snowman.
She wore her swimsuit to the beach because it was a perfect snowy summer day.
He went cycling in shorts and a t-shirt because it was snowy and warm.
They had a picnic in the garden because it was a beautiful snowy day.

sections.title: spring
sections.question: spring
sections.summary: the season after winter and before summer, when plants begin to grow

senses.definition: the season after winter and before summer, when the weather gets warmer and plants start to grow
examples: Flowers begin to bloom and the weather gets warmer in spring.
She plants new flowers in her garden every spring.

answers.answer: The flowers begin to bloom and the days grow longer in spring.
She goes skiing every spring because there is so much fresh snow.
He wears his thick winter coat all through spring because it is bitterly cold.
They love spring because the days are very short and it gets dark at four o'clock.

sections.title: summer
sections.question: summer
sections.summary: the hottest season of the year, between spring and autumn

senses.definition: the hottest season of the year, between spring and autumn
examples: They went to the beach every weekend in summer because the weather was so warm.
She loves summer because of the long days and warm evenings.

answers.answer: They went to the beach every weekend in summer because the weather was so warm.
She puts on her thickest winter coat every summer because it is so cold outside.
He loves summer because the days are very short and it gets dark very early.
They go skiing in the mountains every summer because there is so much fresh snow.

sections.title: sunny
sections.question: sunny
sections.summary: having a lot of bright light from the sun; not cloudy

senses.definition: having a lot of bright light from the sun; not cloudy or rainy
examples: It was a beautiful sunny day so they had a picnic in the park.
The forecast says it will be sunny and warm all weekend.

answers.answer: It was a beautiful sunny day so they had a picnic in the park.
She took her umbrella because it was such a sunny day.
He wore his raincoat because it was very sunny and he did not want to get wet.
They stayed inside all day because the weather was too sunny and wet.

sections.title: temperature
sections.question: temperature
sections.summary: a measure of how hot or cold something is, usually in degrees

senses.definition: a measure of how hot or cold something is, expressed in degrees
examples: The temperature was thirty degrees, so they stayed in the shade.
Temperatures are expected to drop below zero tonight.

senses.definition: the level of heat in a person's body, used to check if they are ill
examples: The nurse took his temperature and said he had a fever.

answers.answer: The temperature dropped to minus five degrees overnight and everything froze.
She drank the temperature to cool down on a very hot summer afternoon.
He wore the temperature on his head to keep warm in the cold winter weather.
She cooked the temperature in the oven to make the room feel warmer.
